name: Wind Surf

seo.title: Wind Surf in the Mediterranean: Windstar's Five-Masted Sailing Yacht | James Wild & Co
seo.description: Wind Surf is Windstar's 346-guest, five-masted sailing yacht. In 2027 and 2028 she sails the Greek Isles weekly from Athens, with spring and autumn voyages to the Amalfi Coast, the Rivieras and Spain.

tagline: Windstar's five-masted flagship, sailing the Greek Isles and the Mediterranean.
answer: Wind Surf is Windstar's flagship sailing yacht: five masts, seven computer-operated sails and 346 guests. From May to October 2027 and 2028 she sails Treasures of the Greek Isles every week from Athens, to Nafplio, Mykonos, Kusadasi for Ephesus, Patmos, Santorini and Monemvasia. In spring and autumn she moves between Lisbon, Barcelona, Rome and Athens on voyages along the coasts of Spain, the French and Italian Rivieras and the Amalfi Coast.
facts: 150 ocean-view staterooms (188 sq ft), 31 suites (376 sq ft) and an Owner's Suite
535 ft (162 m) at the waterline; 615 ft with the bowsprit
5 masts, 221 ft high; 7 self-furling, computer-operated sails
Up to 15 knots under wind and engine
overview: Windstar calls Wind Surf its flagship sailing yacht. She carries 346 guests and 213 crew, and her five masts rise 221 feet, with seven triangular sails that furl themselves at the touch of a button.

Her 2027 and 2028 Mediterranean season starts in Lisbon in April, works east through Spain, the Rivieras and the Amalfi Coast to Athens, sails the Greek Isles every week from May to October, then returns west in the autumn.

On board: Amphora, Basil + Bamboo and the open-air Veranda, a refreshed spa and fitness centre, a sauna, an open bridge, and a watersports platform at the stern for swimming, kayaks and paddleboards at anchor.
why: A real sailing ship, under five masts, small enough for harbours like Portofino, Patmos and Monemvasia.
The Greek Isles every week from Athens, May to October, so the dates fit you.
Spring and autumn voyages join Lisbon, Barcelona, Rome and Athens, with the house's stays on either side.

faqs: How many guests does Wind Surf carry?
Is Wind Surf a real sailing ship?
Yes. She has five masts, 221 feet high, and seven triangular sails that furl automatically; she sails under wind and engine, up to 15 knots.
Where does Wind Surf sail in 2027 and 2028?
The Mediterranean, April to November: Treasures of the Greek Isles every week from Athens from May to October, and voyages between Lisbon, Barcelona, Rome and Athens in spring and autumn.
Which islands does Treasures of the Greek Isles visit?
Nafplio, Mykonos, Kusadasi for Ephesus, Patmos, Santorini and Monemvasia, round trip from Athens in 7 nights.
Staterooms are 188 sq ft and suites 376 sq ft, as Windstar publishes; there is one Owner's Suite and two Broadmoor and Sea Island suites.
Where can I stay before or after?
Ask us: in the Ledger, Palazzo Avino and Hotel Santa Caterina on the Amalfi Coast, Cap Rocat on Mallorca, and Sublime Comporta or Octant Douro in Portugal before Spanish Symphony.
